title: payment.succeeded payload v1
description: A Stripe invoice.paid as the family service stored it, or a booking's one-time payment (a paid payment-mode Checkout Session, no invoice: id is its payment intent, booking names it, and customer is the holder's id in atm). Amounts in cents.

fee_known.description: false when the writer was given no fee (the books then hold the gross amount and `fee` is 0 for want of one); absent in logs written before the handler wrote payments.

booking.description: The caller's booking id, on a booking's payment (no invoice). `reconcile` pairs such a payment with Stripe's payment intents, not its invoices.

session.description: The Checkout Session (cs_...) that collected a booking's payment.

payment_intent.description: The Stripe payment intent (pi_...) of a booking's payment; also its id.
